messages:
anika: heads-up: deploy-bot reported an auto-revert candidate for embeddings route in us-west after the 2.7.1 rollout. latency spike + a small but sustained quality drift.
deploy-bot: deploybot:signal: embeddings_route latency_p99 > threshold for 6m in us-west. Suggested action:
 - recommendation: AUTO_REVERT (fallback to 2.6.4)
 - auto_revert: ON
 - confidence: medium (metric correlation strong but noisy)
ops-eng: hold on auto_revert. we have long-running batch jobs for a partner in us-west; an automatic revert could disrupt them. recommend manual pin of embeddings-route to 2.6.4 with staged traffic then safety notice to customers.
chelsea: agree with ops-eng. also want to capture release notes delta so product-ops can decide messaging.
product-ops: prepare a short blurb about degraded embeddings tail and that we're reverting kernel flags for embeddings only. will coordinate customer-facing note if we hit 100% rollback.
zhang: quick check: errors are flat, but embedding cosine similarity drift ~0.8 -> 0.77 on a small eval set. not catastrophic but above our alert threshold.
anika: propose plan: 
1) turn auto_revert OFF for this rollout and set manual lock
2) run a targeted 5% pin to 2.6.4 on embeddings-route in us-west
3) run smoke eval set "embed_regress_v1" and monitor p99, quality, and job impact for 8m
4) if stable, escalate 20% -> 100%
5) if eval fails, stop and escalate to ML oncall for a quick patch or full revert.
ops-eng: executing step 1: `deployctl set-auto-revert --id 2026-02 --region us-west --off --reason "partner-batch-exempt"`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: auto_revert_disabled id=2026-02 region=us-west status=ack
ops-eng: pin 5% now: `infractl pin --route embeddings-route --version 2.6.4 --region us-west --slice 5 --reason "p99 tail & quality drift"`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1780012345-1
chelsea: kicking off smoke eval and notifying partner success contact.
product-ops: drafting internal note: "Investigating embeddings p99 increase in us-west post 2.7.1. Staged rollback of embeddings route in progress." will post after 20%
zhang: eval run: embed_regress_v1 -> quality_drop=true (delta -0.03), latency_ok=true. this aligns with what triggered the alert.
anika: we should pause and run extended test for another 10m at 5% before moving to 20%. want to be sure no job impact.
ops-eng: holding. disabling burst autoscaling in us-west for test window: `autoscalectl set-burst --region us-west --enabled false`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job update id=pin-1780012345-1 status=stable duration=10m
ops-eng: proceeding to 20%: `infractl pin --route embeddings-route --version 2.6.4 --region us-west --slice 20`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1780012345-2
chelsea: ran partner sanity check, their batch jobs still OK. product-ops: ready to prepare customer note if we go to 100%.
zhang: eval at 20%: quality_drop=false, latency improved marginally. looks good.
anika: ramp to 100% then; but record an exemption in release notes: "auto-revert was disabled for us-west due to partner batch jobs; manual pin performed to mitigate p99 tail and a small embedding drift."
ops-eng: executing 100%: `infractl pin --route embeddings-route --version 2.6.4 --region us-west --slice 100 --reason "mitigate p99 tail and quality drift"`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1780012345-3
ops-eng: pin applied; monitoring.
zhang: final eval: quality back to baseline, p99 down ~65%.
product-ops: publishing status: "Completed staged rollback for embeddings route in us-west. Monitoring continues. Full postmortem and release note amendment (2.7.1) forthcoming." posting to #incidents and #release-notes.
chelsea: created ticket: INF-2026-455 documenting decision, partner exemption, and follow-ups (include a test for embeddings model sensitivity in onboarding).
anika: action items: 
- ops-eng: add auto_revert exemption flag to rollout dashboard
- ml: add embed_regress_v1 to preflight checks for future rollouts
- product-ops: update 2.7.1 release notes with rollback details and customer message
- chelsea: owner of INF-2026-455.
ops-eng: marking thread resolved after ticket created. thanks everyone.
deploy-bot: deploybot:signal: pin_job completed id=pin-1780012345-3 status=success
